sheets.title: Populated, owner and guardian — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: Not a before/after pair. A circle with people in it needs other people’s packets, which a two-build walk cannot stage without faking them. These are screenshots from the five-browser gate (verify:trusted-contacts: an owner, three guardians and a recipient, each in a browser of their own with a virtual security key), walked on this build at this width. The base build has no such screen.
